name: @pipeworx/mcp-advice

tools.name: random_advice
tools.description: Get a random piece of advice. Returns the advice text and slip ID for reference or follow-up queries.

tools.name: search_advice
tools.description: Search for advice by keyword or phrase (e.g., "confidence", "relationships"). Returns matching advice slips with text and IDs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within advice text.

tools.name: get_advice
tools.description: Get a specific advice slip by its numeric ID (e.g., "42"). Returns the full advice text.

id.description: The numeric ID of the advice slip to retrieve.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-advice forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the advice pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
